issue_context.title: Remove unused predicate versions of instructions from API comments
issue_context.body:
Sve.cs contains <summary> blocks with the instruction used for each API method.
For some instructions (eg BIC), there are vector and predicate versions.
For Net 9, we always convert masks to vectors and always use the vector versions of the instructions.

There is #101970 that tracks the requirement to emit the predicated versions of those instructions when all the arguments are masks.
comments: Given we are not doing #101970 for .NET9, then this one should be done for .NET9 instead.

Tagging subscribers to this area: @JulieLeeMSFT, @jakobbotsch
See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.

review_comments:
Why remove these? Aren't we going to be emitting them long term?

The logic is mostly all there, just enabling it for SVE didn't happen in .NET 9
Right, we wanted to keep only the instructions in the summary docs that are enabled in .NET 9.

Its all experimental anyways, so does it matter?

Seems like extra churn and backporting that isn't strictly needed. We didn't do that for AVX512 for example
